summary: Field app for surveying and caring for a city's public art.
description: A local-first field app for a city's public-art conservation team. Conservators survey outdoor artworks and record findings with photos. The app grades condition, schedules the next survey and turns serious findings into a treatment queue. Built with MVUX, Navigation, Toolkit and Material, in English and French, with a city map of every artwork.

messages.content:
Generate a field app for a city's public-art conservation team with:
- a collection of outdoor artworks ranked by urgency, with search, filters and a city map with condition-coloured pins
- an artwork record: photo, condition grade, next survey date, open treatments and survey history
- a condition survey: findings with type, zone, severity and photos, a live grade and an autosaved draft
- a treatment queue: schedule, assign, log and complete work, late work first
- settings for surveyor name, theme, reduced motion, language (English/French), export and import

Include:
- full working code
- navigation between pages
- local storage on the device
- seeded sample data (fictional artworks at real Montréal sites)
Here's **Patina**, your conservation field app! It's built and running in the preview.

suggestedPrompts: Add a filter for overdue surveys
Add a new material with its own survey interval
Show a count of open treatments on the collection page

Patina is a single-project Uno Platform app (Patina/Patina.csproj) targeting Android, iOS, WebAssembly and desktop (Skia), with domain rules in Patina.Core (plain net10.0) and NUnit tests in Patina.Tests. It uses MVUX, Uno.Extensions Navigation, Toolkit and Material.

**Architecture (structural, not an exhaustive file list):**
- **Routes** — App.xaml.cs registers Shell -> Main (nested Collection [default], Queue, Settings) plus Map, Artwork, Survey and Treatment as full-screen siblings. Artwork, Survey and Treatment receive their data through DataViewMap.
- **Pages/Models** — each page in Presentation/ has a matching MVUX *Model.
- **Rules** — Patina.Core/Rules: the worst finding sets the grade (three moderate findings count as Poor); survey intervals depend on material and shorten with condition; submitting a survey proposes one treatment per serious or urgent finding.
- **Data** — stored on the device in ApplicationData.LocalFolder (patina.json plus photos/); on the web that folder lives in IndexedDB. Settings > Export writes a .patina archive.
- **Map** — Controls/ArtworkMap.cs uses Mapsui with OpenStreetMap tiles.
- **Design system** — Styles/ColorPaletteOverride.xaml, Typography.xaml and Tokens.xaml are generated from docs/DESIGN.md with DesignMd2Uno. Edit DESIGN.md, not the generated files.
- **Strings** — English and French. Edit the table in tools/make_resw.py and run it.
- **Known workaround** — the cached pages (MainPage, CollectionPage, SettingsPage) use AdaptiveTrigger instead of {utu:Responsive}; see docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md.
